chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn and Muhammad, the two sons of Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Abdi of Abd Qays, from Daw' ibn Ali al-Ijli, from a man from the people of Persia, whom he named, who said:

I came to Samarra and stayed at the door of Abu Muhammad (عليه السلام). He called me, so I entered upon him and offered greeting. He said, "What has brought you here?" He said: I said, "A desire to serve you." He said: Then he said to me, "Then remain at the door."

He said: So I was in the house with the servants. Then I came to buy necessities for them from the market, and I used to enter upon them without permission when there were men in the house. He said: Then one day I entered upon him while he was in the men's quarters, and I heard movement in the house. So he called to me, "Stay where you are; do not move." So I did not dare either to enter or to leave.

Then a maidservant came out toward me carrying something covered. Then he called to me, "Enter." So I entered, and he called the maidservant, and she returned to him. He said to her, "Uncover what is with you." So she uncovered a fair boy, handsome of face, and she uncovered his belly, and there was hair growing from his throat-pit to his navel, green, not black. Then he said, "This is your master." Then he ordered her, and she carried him away. So I did not see him after that until Abu Muhammad (عليه السلام) passed away.

key_terms.أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ: Abu Muhammad, namely al-Hasan al-Askari (عليه السلام).
key_terms.الْخَدَمِ: The servants in the household with whom the narrator stayed.
key_terms.جَارِيَةٌ: A maidservant who carried the covered child.
key_terms.سَامَرَّاءَ: Samarra, the city where the narrator came to meet Abu Muhammad (عليه السلام).
key_terms.صَاحِبُكُمْ: Your master; the title by which the Imam identified the boy.
key_terms.غُلَامٍ: A young boy who was shown to the narrator.

ai.seo_question: How does this narration from al-Kafi describe a witness seeing the successor of Abu Muhammad al-Hasan al-Askari (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This narration describes a man’s service in the household of Abu Muhammad al-Hasan al-Askari (عليه السلام) and his reported encounter with a hidden young boy whom the Imam identified as "your master." In Shia tradition, the report is treated as one of the textual indications toward the existence and designation of the Imam after Abu Muhammad (عليه السلام).

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn and Muhammad, two sons of Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Ali Bin Abdul Rahman Al Abdy, from Abd Qays, from Zou Bin Ali Al Ijaly, from a man of the people of Persia, he named him, said,

‘I came to Samarra and necessitated the door of Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> (11<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>). So he<sup>asws</sup> invited me in and I went over to him<sup>asws</sup> and greeted. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘What is that which made you come?’ I said, ‘Desire to serve you<sup>asws</sup>’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘So necessitate the door (be a doorman)’.

He said, ‘So I used to be in the house with the servants. Then I came to be buying the necessaries for them from the market, and used to enter upon them from without a permission when there were men in the house. So I went over to him<sup>asws</sup> one day and he<sup>asws</sup> was in the room of the men, and I heard movement in the house. So he<sup>asws</sup> called out to me: ‘(Be) in your place and do not depart!’ So I couldn’t dare to enter nor exit.

So a maid came over to me, and with her was something covered. Then he<sup>asws</sup> called out to me: ‘Enter!’ So I entered, and he<sup>asws</sup> called out to the maid, so she returned to him<sup>asws</sup>. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to her: ‘Uncover from what is with you’. So she uncovered from a white boy, beautiful of face, and she uncovered from his<sup>asws</sup> belly, so there was a growth of green hair from his<sup>asws</sup> belly to his<sup>asws</sup> navel, without blackness. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘This is your Master<sup>asws</sup>’. Then he<sup>asws</sup> ordered her, so she carried him<sup>asws</sup> away, and I did not see him<sup>asws</sup> after that until Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> (11<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) passed away’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from al-Husayn and Muhammad, the sons of Ali ibn Ibrahim from Muhammad ibn Ali ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman al-‘Abdi -from the tribe of ‘Abd Qays- from Daw’ ibn Ali al-‘Ijli from a man of the people of Fars whose name he mentioned and who has said the following.

“I went to Samarra and devoted myself to the gate (of the house) of abu Muhammad (a.s.). The Imam (a.s.) called me. I went to him and offered greetings. He asked me, “ What brings you here?” The narrator has said that he said, “My wish to serve you has brought me here.” He then said, “(Help us) as a devoted (security guard) at the gate.)”

The narrator has said that he then stayed at the gate with other servants. Once then he went to buy the needed items from the market. He would inter the house without formal permission when man were in the house. The narrator has said, “One day I interred the house and he (The Imam (a.s.) was in the men’s quarters. I heard some movement in the house and the Imam (a.s.) said to me, “Stay wherever you are and do not move.” I felt shy of going both inside and outside.

A maiden came out to me with something under a cover with her. Then the Imam (a.s.) called me to come in. I went inside. He called the maiden and she came back to him. He said to her, “Remove the covering from (the face of) who is you. She removed the cover from the face of a white a complexion beautiful boy. The Imam (a.s.) then removed the covering further aside. There was greenish black hair between his neck and belly. The Imam (a.s.) said, “This is you master (Leader with Divine Authority). Then he ordered her to take him and she obeyed. Ever since I did not see him until abu Muhammad (a.s.) left this world.”
